messages:
sarah_sales: Hi team — following up from the discovery call with Veridian Bank. They want customer-managed keys with attested hardware backed vaults, a 30-day pen-test window, and a hard rotation SLA. Can we confirm feasibility + any cost delta?

matt_se: quick Q — are they asking for our private-control-plane Private deployment or Dedicated with BYO-HSM?

sarah_sales: They said 'bring your own HSM' in the RFP but also asked about Redwood's dedicated pools as fallback. Primary ask is HSM attestation + key rotation under customer control.

arya_security: Attestation + FIPS 140-2 level 3 preferred? or is level 2 acceptable? need to know for the SOW.

customer_ciso: FIPS 140-2 Level 3 is preferred, but Level 2 can be accepted for pilot. Final contract will require Level 3 for production. Also need KMIP support and mutual-TLS between our gateway and the keystore.

leo_engops: Noted. For BYO-HSM we need the following from their side: egress IP ranges, VPN / Direct Connect details, and an endpoint supporting either CloudHSM-compatible proxy or KMIP.

matt_se: latency note: their call volume is bursty (80–120 qps) with 2–4s prompt windows. If we route to external HSM per-request, expect token latency +40–120ms per key op. Recommend prefix-KV caching for keys to avoid frequent HSM hits.

arya_security: pen-test window: we can allow a 30-day external pen test against the Private control plane endpoints, but we need 48h notice and a scoped list of targets. Also add contract clause limiting blast radius.

presales_bot: SOW template v3 available: https://redwood.internal/sow/templates/kms-byohsm-v3 — includes attestation checklist and optional hardware addendum.

sarah_sales: thanks bot. Can we get a rough number for the premium on Dedicated vs Hosted when enabling BYO-HSM attestation + FIPS Level 3? customer expects ballpark by EOD.

finance_ops: Ballpark: +15–25% on reserved capacity base price for HSM attestation & support, plus one-time onboarding fee (~$25k) for attestation runbooks and network ops. Precise quote depends on SLOs and support tier.

leo_engops: Ops notes: Onboarding checklist snippet:

```
REDWOOD_KMS_MODE=byo-hsm
REDWOOD_KMS_ENDPOINT=tls://keystore.veridian.local:5696
ALLOWLIST_IPS=[34.120.12.45, 34.120.12.46]
MUTUAL_TLS=true
FIPS_REQUIRED=true
```

We also need their HSM attestation certs and vendor compliance docs.

customer_ciso: We can provide attestations and vendor certs. One ask: can Redwood support rotating the KEK every 7 days with no service disruption? That's our control plane requirement.

matt_se: Rotation every 7 days is aggressive but doable with staged rewrap + cached KV keys. We'll need a canary rollout plan and automatic fallback to pre-rotation KEK for 24 hours. That needs to be in the runbook.

arya_security: Add to SOW: rotation dry-run window, fallback policy, and audit trail retention 1 year. Also SOC2 + PCI attestations required for the contract.

sarah_sales: Action items: 1) SEs to produce a short Ops SOW addendum with rotation/fallback language, 2) Finance to give a draft line-item quote, 3) Security to confirm pen-test rules and attestation requirements. Can we do a sync tomorrow 10am PT?

leo_engops: I can do the addendum. Will post a 1-page runbook draft in thread before 10am.

finance_ops: I'll draft the quote and the one-time onboarding fee breakdown.

arya_security: I'll confirm pen-test scoping and collect required vendor cert checklist.

customer_ciso: Thanks — we'll try to get the network egress IPs and attestation certs by EOD as well.

sarah_sales: perfect. small note: include explicit maintenance window SLA exceptions for quarterly HSM upgrades (they want zero downtime if possible).

matt_se: We'll add a canary + cross-region failover path to minimize downtime, but cannot promise zero downtime for major firmware revs on customer HSMs. We'll document rollback steps.

presales_bot: Reminder: include sample contract clause for "Customer Key Rotation Responsibility" in SOW addendum (see template v3, section 4.2).

sarah_sales: Great — thanks all. If anyone hits a blocker before 10am ping me @sarah_sales. :thumbsup:
